title: Booking and Reversing Held Days on a Bed-Hold Reservation
content:
**Medical records and census desk — Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations.**

Leave days follow the midnight census: a day is a leave day when the resident is away at midnight, so the departure day counts when the resident is gone at midnight, the return day never counts, and an emergency-room visit or outing ending before midnight creates no leave day; a night in hospital observation counts as hospital leave. Held days are booked per service month and day payer at month end or when the leave ends. Held days are booked only while the reservation is held, returned, released or expired. A booked day later found to fall after the return, after a hospital discharge to another setting, inside payer-covered room, or booked in error is reversed against its booked entry. A booked entry is reversed only for dates and a reason not already reversed on it.

### Booked entries

One held-days entry is booked for each service month and each day payer — payer-reserved or resident-private — showing its first held day, its last held day and its day count.

### When booking is allowed

| Reservation status | Held days may be booked |
|---|---|
| held, returned, released or expired | Yes |
| notice pending or declined | No |

### Reversals

| A booked day later found to fall… | Reversal reason |
|---|---|
| after the return | returned earlier |
| after a hospital discharge to another setting | hospital discharged elsewhere |
| inside payer-covered room | payer days available |
| booked in error | billing error |

A reversal names the booked entry it takes days back from, the first reversed day and the reason. The same entry may carry more than one reversal, but never two for the same dates and the same reason.

**Hypothetical.** A resident-private entry booked from the 20th to the 31st is found to include days after a return on the 27th. Days from the 28th onward are reversed against that entry with the reason returned earlier. A later reversal on the same entry for those same dates and that same reason is not made.
